name: adaptive_aero_control_top
description: Bulk storage wrapper for history, payload, and FIFO-like records implemented with a technology-neutral SRAM macro mapping to block RAM or equivalent native memory.
functionality: Stores payload, history, and FIFO-like records in a wrapper around the declared SRAM macro. The wrapper controls the technology-neutral memory interface and exposes read data to the control fabric without flattening bulk storage into registers.
responsibilities: Expose read data to the controller datapath.
Avoid register-array substitution for bulk storage.
reset_behavior: Resets memory control outputs to inactive states. The macro contents are not implicitly overwritten by reset; storage validity is tracked separately by controller logic.
behavior_rules: The wrapper must instantiate the declared SRAM macro by name and instance_name contract.
Bulk payload/history/FIFO storage is not represented as flops or a flattened register bank.
Read data from the macro must be consumed and forwarded to store_rdata.
Write and read accesses follow the macro protocol and may be mapped to native block RAM by the FPGA flow.
